scope: Exploratory repeatedly exposed original30; zero target-person labels; not blind confirmation, cross-day, Cyton, deployment or novelty evidence
fold_rule: Exact original_source_fold from all three prior cases, no resplit; fit all rows of26 source people; validate all rows of3 source people; score same target order>=120
preprocessing: Reuse unchanged fixed8 8-30Hz500sample waveforms; no raw MAT, new filtering, new window, channel selection or target adaptation
feature: Trial-centered sample covariance divided by its own trace, then C_reg=C_norm+0.05*I/8; matrix logarithm, weighted upper triangle, sqrt(2) offdiagonal,36 dimensions. Reuse cyton_covariance.log_covariance and mi_spatial.normalized_covariance
diagonal_control: Eight diagonal entries of SAME log matrix; not standalone channel log powers. No source CSP projection. Changes dimension36to8, not equal capacity
target_feature_extraction: Fixed per-trial stateless transform may run before fitting; no cross-trial fit, labels or target-person calibration; all model selection frozen before target scoring
normalization: StandardScaler fit on26 source people only, separately for36/8 dimensions, no source-validation or target data used to fit
selection: Four C candidates per new branch, max mean3-source-person validation BA, earliest tie/strongest regularization; retain26-only fit, no refit including validation
new_fit_budget: 30 folds x2 branches x4C=240 deterministic fits;60 selected states frozen together. No fake three-seed repetition. New prediction suffix seed0 is a deterministic marker, not a random replicate
primary_metric: Mean30-person BA; reference first averages42/43/44 per person; deterministic new model once per person; same2480 unique target trials

verification.independent_solver: scipy trust-exact analytic sum-logloss+L2 Hessian; gradient infinity norm<=1e-6

bad_trial_policy: Keep6080 original identities/515 author flags, same2480 unique targets/198 flags, no poor-person or poor-trial deletion
hypothesis: Direct full log-covariance with a lightweight source-only classifier improves over frozen source-BN reference; failure of primary gate stops this recipe, not all covariance methods
budget_limitation: New classifier4 source-validation choices versus original neural epoch selection, different dimensions/parameter counts; explicitly not identical compute/tuning capacity
existing_use: Log covariance already exists in GAMEEMO and earlier PhysioNet MI project scripts; current new experiment is on Cho2017 and the exact current split, not a claim of original invention
